current_activity: The I Corps headquarters assembles at Aix-en-Provence as a corps of Army B under Bethouart
notes: Event date: 1 September 1944 (Wikipedia). Gen. Emile Bethouart. Event support: one source family (Wikipedia). Emile Bethouart commands the I Corps (Wikipedia; CMH Riviera to the Rhine, p. 420).

notes: Event date: 20 January 1945 (Wikipedia). Event definition: The I Corps attacks the southern face of the Colmar Pocket on 20 January with the 2nd and 4th Moroccan and 9th Colonial Divisions and tanks of the 1st Armored Division, toward Ensisheim and Cernay. current_activity: End of the Colmar Pocket: the I Corps eliminates the German rearguard at Chalampe on the Rhine
notes: Event date: 9 February 1945 (Wikipedia). Event definition: The I Corps eliminates the German rearguard at the Chalampe bridgehead; with no major German forces left west of the Rhine near Colmar, the Germans blow up the Chalampe bridge.
